newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Blizzards cut power in 400 Bulgarian towns.
newsitem.headline: Blizzards cut power in 400 Bulgarian towns.

text.p: Blizzards on Thursday left almost 400 Bulgarian towns and villages without electricity, cut telephone links in 110 communities and halted traffic at most major airports, the Civil Defence Service said.
Airports in Sofia, Varna and Bourgas were closed. The only operating airport is in the country's second city, Plovdiv, 150 km (100 miles) southeast of Sofia.
Blizzards disrupted road and rail transport in the northeast of the country. Armoured personnel carriers were used in the northeastern town of Dobrich to clear roads and tow away stranded cars.
Bad weather forced the plane of Bulgarian President-Elect Petar Stoyanov, who was returning to Sofia after an official visit to Italy, to land in Bucharest.
The forecast for the next few days was for windy and cold weather.
